results.evidence: Selecting columns after concat must equal selecting the same columns from each frame and concatenating; this catches projection-pushdown ordering and null-handling bugs. Checked frames=2, mismatches=0.
results.invariant: concat(frames).select(cols) must equal concat(frame.select(cols) for frame in frames) for any column subset shared across frames.
results.title: Polars concat-select projection pushdown equivalence

results.evidence: Polars eager and lazy execution paths share the same logical plan; any divergence on pure (no-IO) pipelines indicates a planner-vs-evaluator bug. Checked queries=3, mismatches=0.

results.title: Polars lazy.collect() vs eager pipeline equivalence
